en.description: I love building things for the web and utilizing modern frontend technologies along the way. I combine my background in Economics with over 5 years of software development experience to deliver data-driven solutions that look as good as they perform.
I am also a firm believer in the philosophy of life-long learning and am always looking for ways to expand my skill set and stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends.
Let’s work together and bring your ideas to life!
